title: improve citation for package?
description:
The citation for this package is currently:
```

@Manual{R-phylobase,
  title = {phylobase: Base Package for Phylogenetic Structures and Comparative Data},
  author = {R Hackathon et al.},
  year = {2020},
  note = {R package version 0.8.10},
  url = {https://github.com/fmichonneau/phylobase},
}
```

I'd love for it to be a bit more specific in terms of author so I can give proper credit :)! I assume this means updating the manual.

title: bug in errorbars in barplot.phylo4d
description:
cool package!  

this doesn't seem like it's how it's supposed to errorbars are work:

```
data(navic)
barplot(navic)
sup<-data.frame(IPSS=navic@data$IPSS+2)
inf<-data.frame(IPSS=navic@data$IPSS-3)
row.names(inf)<-navic@label
row.names(sup)<-navic@label
barplot(navic,error.bar.sup = sup,error.bar.inf = inf)
```

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5534161/179640949-518d5538-1700-4118-a65e-da764b113205.png)

maybe an extra minus sign somewhere in the code?

title: Keeping original order of tree
description:
Dear François Michonneau,

Many thanks for writing phylobase. It is an excellent package that is very well documented.

When converting my ape tree to phylo4 with as(tree,"phylo4"), the order of the tips in the tree is changed. Is there any way that one can prevent that from happening? 

Many thanks,
Joana

title: upcoming RNeXML release introduces a new warning
description:
Hey @fmichonneau , @hlapp and I are planning a new RNeXML release, which I'm afraid introduces a new WARNING to the automated check of `phylobase`:

```
New result: WARNING
  Found the following significant warnings:
    Warning: replacing previous import ‘RNeXML::slot<-’ by ‘methods::slot<-’ when loading ‘phylobase’
    Warning: replacing previous import ‘RNeXML::slot’ by ‘methods::slot’ when loading ‘phylobase’
```

I believe this warning actually has no impact on the behavior of `phylobase`, but I'm not sure how / if it can be suppressed, since it is tied up in S4 internals. @hlapp has looked at this more recently and might have some good suggestions?

title: "reorderBinary" not resolved from current namespace (phylobase)
description:
Hi!

When subsetting a tree

`geospiza_subset <- phylobase::subset(geospiza, tips.include = c("Platyspiza", "olivacea", "pauper", "difficilis"))`

I receive the following error:

`Error in .C("reorderBinary", descendantNew, root, ancestor, left, right,  : 
  "reorderBinary" not resolved from current namespace (phylobase)`

The same error is produced when attempting to coerce my own phylo object into the phylo4 class with `as(phylo_object, "phylo4")`. 

I'm not expert enough to know exactly what's happening, but my reading of [this old R help thread](http://r.789695.n4.nabble.com/question-re-error-message-package-error-quot-functionName-quot-not-resolved-from-current-namespace-td4663892.html) (see Martin Morgan's response in particular) suggests it's a problem with the package's namespace.

Cheers,
Jayden

title: provide consistent depth/height functions
description:
Need height functions that provide distance from root:

```
nodeHeight()
tipHeight()
```

and depth function that provide distance from tips:

```
nodeDepth()
```

alternatively, only nodeHeight/tipHeight but provide argument that says "from tip" or "from root"

also need to deprecate `depthTips()` as inconsistent.

title: be consistent on length of node for descendants
description:
this is allowed and works:

```

```

but this doesn't work:

```
descendants(tr, 1:10, "tips")
```

Also check the other tree walking functions to make sure that it's consistent throughout.
